options: so
as
too
to
very
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

This box is _______ heavy _______ that one.
questions.explanation: '~만큼 …한'은 「as+원급+as」로 나타냅니다. 빈칸에는 모두 as가 들어가야 합니다.

options: more
much
most
long
high
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

She eats as _________ as a horse.
questions.explanation: 「as+원급+as」 구문에서 '많이 먹는다'는 의미이므로 much가 알맞습니다. more/most는 비교급·최상급이라 원급 자리에 올 수 없습니다.

options: David has as many pencils Susan.
David has as many pencils as Susan.
David has many as pencils as Susan.
David has as many as pencils Susan.
David has many pencils as Susan.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?

David는 Susan만큼 많은 연필을 가지고 있다.
questions.explanation: 「as many+명사+as」 어순으로 써야 하므로 'as many pencils as Susan'이 올바릅니다.

options: fast / tall / heavy
tall / fast / heavy
taller / faster / heavier
most tall / most fast / heavy
more fast / more tall / heavy
questions.question:
다음 빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

• He is as (A)_________ as his sister.
• Lucas swims as (B)_________ as Mia.
• This bag is as (C)_________ as that one.
questions.explanation: 「as ~ as」 구문에는 원급이 와야 합니다. 형용사 tall, 부사 fast, 형용사 heavy가 알맞습니다.

options: Turtles are not as fast as rabbits.
Turtles are faster than rabbits.
Turtles are less fast than rabbits.
Rabbits are as fast as turtles.
Rabbits are not as fast as turtles.
questions.question:
다음 문장과 의미가 같은 것을 모두 고르면?

Rabbits are faster than turtles.
questions.explanation: '토끼가 거북이보다 빠르다'는 '거북이는 토끼만큼 빠르지 않다(①)', '거북이는 토끼보다 덜 빠르다(③)'와 같은 의미입니다.

options: quiet / beautifully / high
quiet / beautifully / highly
quiet / beautiful / high
quietly / beautiful / highly
quietly / beautiful / high
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 단어로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

• They are as (quiet / quietly) as a mouse.
• Emily sings as (beautiful / beautifully) as she does.
• He jumps as (high / highly) as I do.
questions.explanation: be동사 뒤에는 형용사 quiet, 동사를 꾸밀 때는 부사 beautifully, jump를 꾸밀 때는 부사이면서 '높이'를 뜻하는 high가 알맞습니다.

options: An orange is as not sweet as an apple.
An orange is not as sweet as an apple.
An orange is not also sweet as an apple.
An orange is not very sweet as an apple.
An orange is very not sweet as an apple.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?

오렌지는 사과만큼 달지는 않다.
questions.explanation: '~만큼 …하지 않다'는 「not as+원급+as」로 나타냅니다. not이 as 앞에 와야 합니다.

options: He can never jump as high than the boy can.
The boy can never jump as high so he can.
He cannot jump as higher than the boy can.
The boy cannot jump as higher as he can.
He can never jump as high as the boy can.
questions.question:
다음 문장을 영어로 바르게 잘 옮긴 것은?

그는 그 소년만큼 높이 뛸 수 없다.
questions.explanation: 「as+원급+as」 구문을 써야 하므로 'as high as the boy can'이 올바릅니다.

options: The ostrich's egg is as big as a chick.
A chick is not as big as the ostrich's egg.
The ostrich's egg is very big a chick.
A chick is as biggest as the ostrich's egg.
The ostrich's egg is as a chick as big.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?

타조의 알은 병아리 한 마리만큼 크다.
questions.explanation: 「as+원급+as」 어순으로 'as big as a chick'이 올바릅니다.

options: My bag is as heavy as yours.
My bag is heavier than yours.
Your bag is heavier than mine.
Your bag is not so heavy as mine.
Your bag is very heavy.
questions.question:
다음 두 문장과 같은 의미를 가진 것은?

My bag is 2 kilograms heavy.
Your bag is 2 kilograms heavy, too.
questions.explanation: 두 가방의 무게가 같으므로 '내 가방은 네 것만큼 무겁다'는 「as heavy as」로 표현합니다.

options: ①
②
③
④
⑤
questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 어색한 것은?

① My sister is <u>as busy as</u> a bee.
② The shirt looks <u>as nice</u> mine.
③ Kevin walks <u>as slowly as</u> she does.
④ Amy sings <u>as sweetly as</u> the girl.
⑤ I can read French <u>as fluently as</u> him.
questions.explanation: 「as+원급+as」는 두 번째 as가 반드시 있어야 합니다. ②는 'as nice mine'으로 두 번째 as가 빠져 어색하며 'as nice as mine'으로 써야 합니다. ①③④⑤는 모두 올바릅니다.

options: Jane is as tallest as her mother.
This bus is as faster as that bus.
The rope is as long as that string.
This nut is as harder as a stone.
This box is as heavier as that bag.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: 「as ~ as」 구문에는 원급이 와야 합니다. ③만 원급 long이 바르게 쓰였습니다.

options: Mina's hands are as small as Suji's.
My sister is as taller as my mother.
He isn't so kind as you.
She is much lighter than my sister.
Jun wakes up as early as his brother.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 원급 비교 「as+원급+as」에서는 비교급(taller)이 아니라 원급(tall)을 써야 하므로 as tall as로 고쳐야 합니다.

options: Jinho swims as fast as Taeho.
Nara reads as much as Somin.
Jaemin speaks Japanese as good as I do.
She is as bright as a star.
You remember dates as many as she does.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것을 모두 고르면? (2개)
questions.explanation: ③은 동사 speaks를 꾸미므로 부사 well을 써서 as well as로, ⑤는 remember의 목적어(정보의 양)를 나타내므로 as much as로 고쳐야 합니다. good, many는 문맥에 맞지 않습니다.

options: I am as busy as a bee.
He is as tall as a mouse.
She is as gentle as a lamb.
Kate is as light as a feather.
Sam is as strong as an ox.
questions.question: 다음 동등비교 표현이 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 쥐(mouse)는 작은 동물이므로 '키가 크다(tall)'와 비유가 어울리지 않습니다. 나머지는 원급 비교 관용 표현으로 자연스럽습니다.

options: I have practiced as long as you.
Cooking is not as hard as baking.
Their garden is twice as wide as my garden.
Watching movies is as fun as playing games.
The new phone is as twice expensive as the old one.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 배수사는 「배수사+as+원급+as」의 어순으로 쓰므로 twice as expensive as로 고쳐야 합니다. as twice expensive as는 어순이 틀립니다.

options: I will call her <u>as often as possible</u>.
I will wake up <u>as early as possible</u>.
I will finish the work <u>as quickly as possible</u>.
Reply to me <u>as soon as possible</u>.
Save money <u>as many as possible</u>.
questions.question: 다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분이 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: money는 셀 수 없는 명사이므로 many가 아니라 much를 써서 as much as possible로 고쳐야 합니다.

options: You read more books than me. = I read as many books as you.
We sang better than them. = They didn't sing as well as us.
You arrived earlier than me. = I didn't arrive as early as you.
My room is smaller than yours. = Your room isn't as small as mine.
I've lived here longer than you. = You haven't lived here as long as me.
questions.question: 다음 중 짝지어진 두 문장의 의미가 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: '너는 나보다 책을 더 많이 읽었다'는 두 사람이 다르다는 뜻이지만, 'I read as many books as you'는 같다는 뜻이므로 의미가 다릅니다.

options: ⓐ Does you know → Do you know
ⓑ as tallest as a house → as tall as a house
ⓒ the longest neck in the animal world → as longest neck in the animal world
ⓓ Its tongue look like → Its tongue looks like
ⓔ It's legs are very long → Its legs are very long
questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ를 바르게 고친 것이 어색한 것은?

ⓐDoes you know this animal? It is about 3 m tall. It is ⓑas tallest as a house. It has ⓒthe longest neck in the animal world. ⓓIts tongue look like a long rope. ⓔIt's legs are very long. It eats leaves.
questions.explanation: ⓒ는 최상급 표현(the longest ~ in ...)으로 이미 올바른 문장입니다. as longest as로 고치는 것은 오히려 틀린 표현이므로 어색합니다.

options: Amy is as clever as her brother. = Amy and her brother are equally clever.
Ben can jump as high as a kangaroo. = Ben jumps very high like a kangaroo.
Mina drinks as much as a camel. = Mina drinks a large amount of water as a camel does.
Jiho is as tall as the fence in the garden. = Jiho and the fence are the same in height.
Sora's work is not as much as Yena's. = Sora has more work than Yena has.
questions.question: 다음 중 두 문장의 의미가 같지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 'Sora's work is not as much as Yena's'는 소라의 일이 예나보다 적다는 뜻인데, 오른쪽 문장은 소라가 더 많다고 했으므로 의미가 다릅니다.

options: Nina
Leo
Jack
Max
Ben
questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고, 키가 가장 큰 사람을 고르시오.

Nina is not shorter than Leo.
Jack is shorter than Max.
Leo is as tall as Jack.
Max is taller than Nina.
Nina is as tall as Ben.
questions.explanation: Leo=Jack, Nina≥Leo, Max>Jack, Max>Nina이므로 Max가 가장 큽니다. Jack<Max, Leo=Jack, Nina=Ben이므로 Max가 최고 키입니다.

options: Ann is as heavy as Cara.
Cara is as tall as Ben.
Ann is as tall as Cara.
Ben is taller than Ann.
Ben is not as heavy as Cara.
questions.question:
다음 표의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

| | Ann | Ben | Cara |
|--------|-------|-------|-------|
| Weight | 50kg | 52kg | 52kg |
| Height | 162cm | 160cm | 162cm |
questions.explanation: Ann과 Cara의 키가 둘 다 162cm이므로 'Ann is as tall as Cara'가 맞습니다. Ben과 Cara의 몸무게는 둘 다 52kg으로 같으므로 ⑤도 틀립니다.

options: Eric is as tall as Fred.
Dana is as tall as Eric.
Fred is not as old as Eric.
Dana is older than Eric.
Fred is smaller than Dana.
questions.question:
다음 표를 바르게 해석한 것은?

| | Dana | Eric | Fred |
|------------|-------|-------|-------|
| height(cm) | 158 | 152 | 168 |
| age | 16 | 16 | 15 |
questions.explanation: Fred는 15세, Eric은 16세이므로 'Fred is not as old as Eric(Fred는 Eric만큼 나이가 많지 않다)'이 맞습니다. Dana와 Eric은 같은 나이이고, Fred가 가장 큽니다.

options: Sam is as old as Ray.
Sam is older than Leo.
Leo isn't as old as Ray.
Tom is not older than Sam.
Tom is the oldest of the four.
questions.question:
다음 표에 대한 설명 중 잘못된 것은?

| | Sam | Leo | Ray | Tom |
|------|------|------|------|-------|
| Age | 15 | 14 | 15 | 16 |
questions.explanation: Tom은 16세, Sam은 15세이므로 Tom이 Sam보다 나이가 많습니다. 따라서 'Tom is not older than Sam'은 사실과 다릅니다.

options: Sam is taller than Kate.
Sam is as tall as Leo.
Kate is taller than Leo.
Sam is heavier than Kate.
Kate is not as heavy as Leo.
questions.question:
다음 표의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

| | Sam | Kate | Leo |
|--------|---------|---------|----------|
| height | 170cm | 158cm | 170cm |
| weight | 60kg | 52kg | 68kg |
questions.explanation: Kate의 키는 158cm이고 Leo의 키는 170cm이므로 Kate가 Leo보다 크지 않다. 따라서 'Kate is taller than Leo.'는 표와 일치하지 않는다.
